verses.text: This is the message of judgment against Egypt: "Look, the LORD is riding on a fast cloud and coming to Egypt. The idols of Egypt tremble before him, and the hearts of the Egyptians melt with fear.
I will turn Egyptians against Egyptians. Brother will fight brother, and neighbor will fight neighbor. City will fight city, and kingdom will fight kingdom.
The Egyptians will lose heart, and I will bring their plans to nothing. They will ask their idols, the spirits of the dead, the mediums, and the fortune tellers for help.
I will hand the Egyptians over to a cruel master, and a fierce king will rule over them," says the Lord GOD of Armies.
The waters of the river will dry up, and the Nile will become empty and dry.
The canals will stink. The streams of Egypt will shrink and dry up. The reeds and rushes will wither.
The plants along the Nile, at the edge of the river, and every field planted by the Nile, will dry up, blow away, and be gone.
The fishermen will cry and mourn. Everyone who throws a hook into the Nile will be sad, and those who spread nets on the water will lose heart.
Those who work with combed flax will be in despair, and the weavers of fine white cloth will lose hope.
The workers who weave cloth will be crushed, and all who work for wages will be sick at heart.
The officials of Zoan are complete fools. Pharaoh's wisest advisers give stupid advice. How can you say to Pharaoh, "I am one of the wise men, a son of ancient kings"?
Where are your wise men now? Let them tell you and show you what the LORD of Armies has planned against Egypt.
The officials of Zoan have become fools. The leaders of Memphis are fooled. The leaders of its tribes have led Egypt astray.
The LORD has poured into them a spirit of confusion. They make Egypt stagger in everything it does, like a drunk person staggering in their own vomit.
There is nothing Egypt can do, no one at all, head or tail, palm branch or reed.
On that day the Egyptians will be weak like frightened women. They will shake with fear when the LORD of Armies raises his hand against them.
The land of Judah will terrify the Egyptians. Everyone who hears Judah's name will be afraid, because of what the LORD of Armies has planned against them.
On that day five cities in Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and promise to be loyal to the LORD of Armies. One of them will be called the City of Destruction.
On that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the middle of Egypt, and a stone pillar to the LORD at its border.

It will be a sign and a witness to the LORD of Armies in the land of Egypt. When they cry out to the LORD because of those who treat them cruelly, he will send them a savior and defender, and he will rescue them.
The LORD will make himself known to Egypt, and on that day the Egyptians will know the LORD. They will worship him with sacrifices and offerings. They will make promises to the LORD and keep them.
The LORD will strike Egypt, but he will also heal it. They will turn to the LORD, and he will listen to their prayers and heal them.
On that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt, and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.
On that day Israel will join Egypt and Assyria as the third, a blessing in the middle of the earth.
The LORD of Armies will bless them and say, "Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my special possession."
